body_md:
This page lists six family-owned plumbing businesses that serve Tampa, each with a Florida Certified Plumbing Contractor license checked on a state record. Every license was Current and Active and expires on August 31, 2028. Owner, service area, hours, phone, and website details come only from the facts checked on November 12, 2026.

## How we picked

Each listing was included after a Florida DBPR check of the Certified Plumbing Contractor license: number, status, expiration, qualifier, and license address or location. License facts link to that DBPR source. Owner, service area, hours, and features link to the cited website. Contacts were checked on November 12, 2026. Listings are not ranked or rated.

## At a glance

- Licensure dates are listed for Olin Plumbing Inc (May 8, 2009, CFC1428000) and Complete Plumbing and Drain LLC (March 5, 2019, CFC1430251). Other numbers are CFC1428537 (EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC), CFC1430231 (Titan Plumbing and Electric), CFC019219 (Alvarez Plumbing and Air Conditioning), and CFC1431159 (Home Therapist Cooling, Heating, and Plumbing). All six expire August 31, 2028.
- Stated time frames: Alvarez Plumbing and Air Conditioning since 1976; Titan Plumbing and Electric in business since 1994; EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC since 2012; Home Therapist Cooling, Heating, and Plumbing family-owned since 2017; Complete Plumbing and Drain LLC launched in 2019. Olin Plumbing Inc’s site states more than 50 years of experience in the plumbing trade.
- Olin Plumbing Inc, Titan Plumbing and Electric, Alvarez Plumbing and Air Conditioning, and Home Therapist list Hillsborough, Pinellas, and Pasco counties. Alvarez also lists Tampa and the surrounding Tampa Bay area. EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC lists Hillsborough County, Pinellas County, and southern Pasco County. Complete Plumbing and Drain LLC, in Seffner, lists Tampa, Brandon, Valrico, Riverview, Lakeland, Plant City, Wesley Chapel, and Seffner.
- Alvarez lists 24/7. Olin lists 24-hour emergency service every day, including holidays. Home Therapist’s site states open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Titan lists Monday–Saturday open 24 hours and Sunday closed. EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC lists office hours Monday–Friday 8:00am–5:00pm and emergency dispatch outside office hours.

## Things to know before you go

Match the license name before you call. Titan Plumbing and Electric’s record uses BATH & KITCHEN GALLERY, INC., at 8406 Mitchell Ave, Tampa, FL 33604. The site address in these facts is 8407 N Mitchell Ave, Tampa, FL 33604. Alvarez Plumbing and Air Conditioning names the Alvarez family as owner; a Florida filing lists Marcus Reyes as president; the qualifier is Alfonso Alvarez Jr. Home Therapist states plumbing work is done under Alejandro Morales’s CFC license.

For Sunday or a holiday, read the hours line. Titan lists Sunday closed. Olin includes holidays in its 24-hour emergency service. EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC separates weekday office hours from emergency dispatch.

Listed price and service notes are specific to the business that states them. Olin lists up-front pricing with no hidden fees, state certified backflow testing with a dedicated backflow department, a 1-year residential drain cleaning guarantee, and sending plumbers rather than service techs. EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC lists upfront pricing before work starts and a 10% discount for military, veterans, and seniors on services under $2,500. Titan lists a flat-rate price quoted before work begins, and its site says the same crew handles plumbing and electrical work. Home Therapist’s site states free estimates and free diagnosis. Alvarez states financing is available for larger jobs. Complete Plumbing and Drain LLC suggests plumbing inspections about once a year.

## FAQ

### Were these licenses active when checked?
Yes. Each Certified Plumbing Contractor license was Current and Active on its Florida DBPR source. All six expire August 31, 2028. Contacts were checked on November 12, 2026.

### Who is named as the owner?
Derek Olin at Olin Plumbing Inc; Chris McConnell at Complete Plumbing and Drain LLC; Jacqueline "Jackie" Hamlin and Mike Haisten at EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC; Joseph Ferrantegennaro at Titan Plumbing and Electric; the Alvarez family at Alvarez Plumbing and Air Conditioning; and Alejandro Morales and Richard Morales at Home Therapist Cooling, Heating, and Plumbing. A Florida filing lists Marcus Reyes as president of Alvarez Plumbing and Air Conditioning. Its site states it was founded by Al Alvarez Jr., is still run by the family, and is veteran-owned and minority-owned. EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC states the same founders still operate it. Each listing describes the business as family-owned.

### What hours are stated?
Alvarez Plumbing and Air Conditioning lists 24/7. Olin Plumbing Inc lists 24-hour emergency service every day, including holidays. Home Therapist’s site states open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Titan Plumbing and Electric lists Monday–Saturday open 24 hours and Sunday closed. EVERYDAYPLUMBER.COM LLC lists office hours Monday–Friday 8:00am–5:00pm and emergency dispatch outside office hours. Hours are not in these facts for Complete Plumbing and Drain LLC.
